question: How many movies are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies

question: How many ratings are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ratings

question: What is the overall average rating?
sql: SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM ratings

question: Which 10 movies have the most ratings?
sql: SELECT m.title, COUNT(*) AS n_ratings FROM ratings r JOIN movies m ON m.movieid = r.movieid GROUP BY m.movieid, m.title ORDER BY n_ratings DESC LIMIT 10

question: Top 10 highest-average-rated movies with at least 50 ratings.
sql: SELECT m.title, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n_ratings FROM ratings r JOIN movies m ON m.movieid = r.movieid GROUP BY m.movieid, m.title HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many movies are there per genre?
sql: SELECT g AS genre, COUNT(*) AS n_movies FROM movies, unnest(string_to_array(genres, '|')) AS g GROUP BY g ORDER BY n_movies DESC

question: Which user has rated the most movies?
sql: SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS n_ratings FROM ratings GROUP BY userid ORDER BY n_ratings DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average rating per release year?
sql: WITH y AS (SELECT movieid, substring(title FROM '\((\d{4})\)\s*$')::int AS release_year FROM movies) SELECT y.release_year, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM ratings r JOIN y ON y.movieid = r.movieid WHERE y.release_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY y.release_year ORDER BY y.release_year

question: What are the 10 most frequently used tags?
sql: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tags GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

question: Distribution of rating values (how many 0.5, 1.0, ... 5.0).
sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ratings GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

question: How many orders are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: What is the total revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items

question: Top 10 product categories by revenue (English names).
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many orders per order_status?
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY n DESC

question: Distribution of payment types.
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY n DESC

question: Top 10 sellers by total revenue.
sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Number of orders per customer state.
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY n_orders DESC

question: Average number of items per order.
sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) x

question: How many matches are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Match"

question: How many players are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Player"

question: How many matches per league?
sql: SELECT l.name AS league, COUNT(*) AS n_matches FROM "Match" m JOIN "League" l ON l.id = m.league_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY n_matches DESC

question: Average goals per match by league.
sql: SELECT l.name AS league, AVG(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS avg_goals FROM "Match" m JOIN "League" l ON l.id = m.league_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY avg_goals DESC

question: Home-win vs away-win vs draw counts overall.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS away_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draws FROM "Match"
